dialogue.text: FunkBucks is the main currency here.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: However there isn't much to spend them on aside currently from the Boxes.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: You can earn FunkBucks by completing Songs and Weeks.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: Beward though, your 5 most recently completed Songs or Weeks are added to a penalty list.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: The more times that a Song or Week is on there,<d=0.25/> the less FunkBucks you'll earn for completing it again.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: The penalty is displayed at the Bottom-Left (in Freeplay) or Bottom-Right (in Story Mode).
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: So try to play a variety of Songs and Weeks, alright?.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia
